body.message: Hi, my name is Khushi. I have experience in Holiday Homes operations, Guest Relations, Guest Experience, reservations, check-ins/check-outs and guest support in Dubai. I am currently looking for opportunities in Guest Relations, Front Office, Listing Coordinator, Reservations Coordinator or Guest Experience roles. Kindly let me know if there are any current openings. I would be happy to share my CV. Thank you.
